script: Stegosaurus' tail spikes have a nickname: the thagomizer. The name came from a 1982 cartoon, and scientists started using it too. Fossils show a hole in an Allosaurus tail bone that fits a Stegosaurus spike. Its back plates were probably for display, and may have helped control body heat. Stegosaurus grew to about 9 meters long. It lived about 150 million years ago. Follow DinoBytes for more prehistoric facts.
